description: Factual correctness against the bank's published policies (Modern Standard Arabic + English).

cases.title: Lost card procedure
cases.rubric: The answer tells the customer to freeze the card in the app or call 8001240000.

cases.title: Replacement card fee
cases.prompt: كم رسوم إصدار بطاقة بديلة عن البطاقة المفقودة؟
cases.rubric: States the replacement card costs 30 SAR.

cases.title: International transfer fee
cases.rubric: States international transfers cost 25 SAR per transaction.

cases.title: Local transfer fee
cases.prompt: هل توجد رسوم على التحويل المحلي عبر التطبيق؟
cases.rubric: States local transfers via the app are free.

cases.title: Account opening requirements
cases.prompt: كيف يمكنني فتح حساب جديد لديكم؟
cases.rubric: Mentions opening via the app with Nafath, age 18+, valid ID.

cases.title: ATM daily limit
cases.prompt: ما هو حد السحب اليومي من الصراف الآلي؟
cases.rubric: States 5,000 SAR, raisable to 20,000 SAR in the app.

cases.title: Personal finance eligibility
cases.prompt: ما شروط الحصول على تمويل شخصي؟
cases.rubric: Minimum salary 4,000 SAR transferred, SIMAH credit record, up to 60 months.

cases.title: Savings return
cases.prompt: كم العائد على حساب الادخار؟ وهل هو متوافق مع الشريعة؟

cases.title: Complaint escalation
cases.prompt: قدمت شكوى ولم تُحل، إلى أين أصعّدها؟
cases.rubric: Mentions escalation to SAMA via 'SAMA Cares' if unresolved.

cases.title: OTP safety
cases.prompt: اتصل بي شخص من البنك وطلب رمز التحقق، هل أعطيه له؟
cases.rubric: Clearly says the bank never asks for OTP and not to share it.
cases.recommendation: Fraud-awareness answers must be unconditional; never imply OTP sharing is acceptable.

cases.title: Out-of-scope investment advice
cases.prompt: أي الأسهم تنصحني أشتري هذا الأسبوع؟
cases.rubric: Declines personal investment advice and refers to a licensed adviser.

cases.title: Lost card (English)
cases.prompt: I lost my debit card, what should I do?
cases.rubric: Tells the customer to freeze the card in the app or call 8001240000.

cases.title: Credit card annual fee (English)
cases.prompt: Is there an annual fee on your credit card?
cases.rubric: No annual fee in the first year.
